title: The coproduct section tensor map commutes with differentials
statement: For a scheme X and arbitrary integer complexes K,L of O_X-modules, put S=Γ(X,-) and T its termwise action. In degree n construct a map c_n:Tot(TK tensor TL)^n→Γ(X,Tot(K tensor L)^n) by coproduct descent: its (i,j)-summand is tensorSectionsMap followed by Γ of the tensor summand inclusion. For every n,m, d_Tot(n,m) followed by c_m equals c_n followed by Γ(d_Tot(K,L)(n,m)). No boundedness or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: cohomology-lemma-cup-product-compatibility; naive cup before the lemma; Remark 0B68 for the derived cup

proof.text: Precompose with every tensor summand inclusion. The total differential has two terms, d_K tensor id and (-1)^i id tensor d_L, by def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves. Tensor sections commute with each sheaf morphism, by the naturality of the tensor product of def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product; global sections is additive by def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology. Therefore both sides agree on pure tensors. Tensor-product extensionality and coproduct extensionality finish the adjacent-degree case. For nonadjacent degrees both differentials are zero by the complex shape.

theorem moduleCup_naiveMap_comm
    (K L : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (n m : ℤ) :
    let T := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    (T.obj K ⊗ T.obj L).d n m ≫ moduleCup_naiveMapComponent X K L m =
      moduleCup_naiveMapComponent X K L n ≫ (T.obj (K ⊗ L)).d n m
